user.title: Select operator
user.description: Choose your distribution operator. Kyiv oblast (KREM) and Kyiv city (KEM) have different operators.

city.title: Select city
city.description: Choose the city or settlement where your address is located.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to check DTEK for outage updates. Default is 300 seconds (5 minutes). Minimum 60 seconds, maximum 3600 seconds (1 hour).

connection.title: What would you like to connect?
connection.description: Building schedules work without signing in. The personal account adds readings, consumption and meter details. Kyiv oblast and Dnipropetrovsk oblast cabinets are experimental.

account_login.title: Sign in to your personal account
account_login.description:
Enter your DTEK phone number and password. Readings are sent only after your confirmation.

[Create an account]({signup_url}) · [Forgot your password?]({recovery_url})

Return here after registration or password recovery. Your password is stored in Home Assistant configuration. Use the same account when signing in again.

accounts.title: Select personal accounts
accounts.description: Choose the accounts to connect. Each keeps its own readings and settings. View them separately in My DTEK or add a card for each. Apartment data is not shared with the building bot. You can configure the building schedule and home sensor later.

account_access.title: Connect your DTEK account
account_access.description: Sign in, create an account or recover access by SMS. Opening a form does not send an SMS.

account_register.title: Create a DTEK account · phone
account_register.description: Enter your phone number. Continuing sends an SMS from DTEK. Already registered? Choose Sign in or Forgot your password instead.

account_recover.title: Recover access · phone
account_recover.description: Enter the phone number registered with DTEK. Continuing sends an SMS. Checking the code does not change your password; you choose a new password in a separate step.

account_sms.title: Enter the SMS code
account_sms.description: DTEK sent a four-digit code to {phone}. Enter it and continue. To request another SMS, select Resend; leave the code empty. Allow at least 60 seconds between requests.

data.resend: Send another SMS instead of checking a code

account_profile.title: Create a DTEK account · your name
account_profile.description: DTEK needs your name to create the account. These details are sent to DTEK and are not saved in the HA connection settings.

account_registration_password.title: Create a DTEK account · password
account_registration_password.description:
Choose 8–64 characters, with at least two uppercase letters, one lowercase letter and one digit; no spaces. Continuing creates the account on DTEK and signs you in to HA. HA stores the password in its configuration.

Review the registration information on the [official DTEK website]({signup_url}).

data.accept_terms: I agree to DTEK processing my personal data and to creating the account

account_recovery_password.title: Set a new DTEK password
account_recovery_password.description:
Your phone number is confirmed. Continuing changes your password on the DTEK website and signs you in to HA. Cancel now to keep the current password.

Choose 8–64 characters, with at least two uppercase letters, one lowercase letter and one digit; no spaces. HA stores the new password in its configuration.

data.confirm_change: Change my DTEK password to the one entered above

account_access_login.title: Finish connecting your account
account_access_login.description: DTEK confirmed account creation or the password change. The HA connection is not complete yet. Sign in with the new password; SMS and password changes will not be repeated.

account_setup.title: Choose household accounts
account_setup.description: Connect accounts already linked to your DTEK cabinet, or add one by its number and verify the address. A new cabinet may be empty.

menu_options.accounts: Choose accounts to monitor in HA
menu_options.account_link: Add an account to the DTEK cabinet
menu_options.account_finish_empty: Connect the cabinet without monitoring accounts yet

account_management.title: Household accounts
account_management.description: DTEK cabinet links and HA monitoring are separate. Unlinking an account does not close its electricity contract.

account_link.title: Find a household account
account_link.description: Enter the modern {account_length}-digit account number from your DTEK receipt for the selected operator (number starts with: {account_prefixes}). This step only looks up the address. Legacy numbers and commercial accounts are not supported here.

account_link_confirm.title: Add this account to DTEK?
account_link_confirm.description:
Account: **{number}**

Address: **{address}**

Confirm that this is your account. This adds it to your DTEK cabinet. You will choose HA monitoring separately afterwards.

data.confirm: The account and address are correct; add it to my DTEK cabinet

account_linked.title: Account added to DTEK
account_linked.description: The DTEK cabinet link is saved. Continue to choose which accounts HA monitors. Closing this window keeps the DTEK link and leaves your current HA selection unchanged.

account_unlink.title: Unlink an account from DTEK
account_unlink.description: Choose an account linked to this cabinet. First deselect it under “Choose which accounts HA monitors” and wait for HA to reload. Another confirmation will follow.

account_unlink_confirm.title: Confirm unlinking from DTEK
account_unlink_confirm.description:
Account: **{number}**

Address: **{address}**

The account will disappear from this DTEK cabinet. Its electricity contract and billing history are not deleted. Stored HA sensor references are retained.

data.confirm: Unlink this account from my DTEK cabinet

account_link_legacy.title: Find a household account
account_link_legacy.description: Enter the modern account number: {account_length} digits starting with {account_prefixes}, or an old 11-digit Kyiv city number. DTEK will resolve the current number. Review the number and address before linking; choose the correct account if several match.

account_legacy_choice.title: Choose the matching account
account_legacy_choice.description: DTEK found several accounts. Choose the correct number and address. Linking requires a separate confirmation.

account_access_experimental.title: Experimental regional cabinet
account_access_experimental.description: Cabinet functions and apartment-group lookup are enabled for this operator, but have not yet been tested with a real linked household account. Check the returned address, meter and tariff zones. Report problems in [GitHub Issues]({issues_url}) without passwords or account details. Opening a form does not send an SMS.

create_entry.account_connected:
**Your cabinet is connected.**

To open it on a dashboard:

1. Finish setup and reload the HA page.
2. Open your dashboard → Edit dashboard → Add card, then search for **My DTEK**.
3. Choose the personal account for this card and save. You can add another card for a different account.

In My DTEK, open **Settings** to connect a building schedule. A **home energy sensor is optional**: any suitable cumulative kWh sensor can suggest readings; you can also enter readings manually. Nothing is submitted to DTEK without confirmation.

The building for outage schedules is matched automatically. If the address is ambiguous, confirm it in Building and outage group. A single verified cabinet group or the building’s only group is selected automatically. Otherwise, choose your apartment group in settings.
create_entry.account_connected_empty:
**Your cabinet is connected; no personal accounts are monitored yet.**

Open **Settings → Devices & services → DTEK Monitor → Configure** to add an account or choose which existing accounts HA monitors. You do not need to sign in again.

Then reload the HA page, edit a dashboard, choose **Add card → My DTEK**, and select an account. Building schedules and a home energy sensor can be configured later.

account_schedule.description: Choose the apartment account. This private selection keeps every group in the building schedules and bot.

account_schedule_address.description: The building is matched automatically when the address is unambiguous. Review it or choose another from the directory. Do not link a building disables automatic linking for this account; the building and bot schedules remain.

account_schedule_groups.description: Building: {building}. Leave the group selection empty to use one verified cabinet group, or the only building group. data.use_cabinet_groups: Look up apartment groups in the DTEK cabinet

account_reminder_settings.title: Home Assistant reminders
account_reminder_settings.description: One reminder per period: the last two days of the month and the first three of the next, in Kyiv time. Dismissing it stops reminders for that period. Notifications are visible to users of this HA; the account number is masked. No readings are submitted automatically. Use the account device button to preview.

account_checks.title: Scheduled reading checks
account_checks.description: Choose the account for local checks. Nothing is submitted to DTEK.

account_check_settings.title: Reading checks · {account}
account_check_settings.description: A check calculates readings from the bound sensor and compares them with the cabinet. It never submits readings or changes calibration. See the result and journal in the Reading check sensor. Time zone: Europe/Kyiv. After downtime, only today’s check is performed.

account_notice_settings.title: Home Assistant notifications
account_notice_settings.description: Separate notifications for this account, off by default. Verification: a reminder in the year specified by DTEK and subsequent years, without assuming an exact due date. Replacement: a changed meter number after the first observation. Data refreshes every 6 hours; dismissed notices stay dismissed until a new event. Sensor bindings do not transfer to a new meter automatically. Notifications are visible to users of this HA; the account number is masked.

account_api_changed.title: Check DTEK API compatibility
account_api_changed.description:
The **{interface}** interface is unavailable or returned an incompatible response ({reason}). DTEK may have changed or disabled it.

Check [DTEK Monitor updates]({releases_url}). If you already use the latest version, [report the problem]({issues_url}) with the interface and reason shown here. Do not include passwords, tokens or full account numbers.

This issue clears automatically after successful requests resume.

account_groups_api_changed.title: Legacy cabinet group lookup needs an update
account_groups_api_changed.description:
The optional account-group service is unavailable or its response format changed ({reason}). This affects group lookup through the legacy cabinet. Meter data, reading submission and building schedules work independently. You can choose your group manually or disable cabinet lookup in group settings.

Check [integration updates]({releases_url}). If you already use the latest version, [report the issue]({issues_url}) with the reason and interface: {interface}. Omit credentials and full account numbers. This issue clears after recovery or after lookup is disabled for this connection.
